stories.title: Un hombre mata a su pareja a puñaladas en La Campana y se atrinchera en una casa

en.title: A man kills his partner with stab wounds in La Campana and barricades himself in a house
en.summary: A 47-year-old woman was fatally stabbed in La Campana, Seville on Saturday evening. Her 56-year-old partner is suspected of the killing and has barricaded himself in a house.

stories.title: La policía británica detiene a varios sospechosos por manejar explosivos cerca de la base militar aérea de Fairford

en.title: British police detain several suspects for handling explosives near RAF Fairford military base
en.summary: British police arrested multiple suspects in connection with explosives found near RAF Fairford, where U.S. fighter jets operate in military operations.

stories.title: El alcalde de Nueva York, Zohran Mamdani, publica un vídeo con Sánchez: "Ser de izquierdas significa intentar tiros difíciles"

en.title: New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani publishes a video with Sánchez: "Being left-wing means attempting difficult shots"
en.summary: The New York mayor and Spanish politician appear in a video where they mimic basketball players shooting paper balls into a trash can. The Spanish opposition party criticized the video as disconnected from reality.

stories.title: Muere una mujer apuñalada por su pareja en La Campana (Sevilla), que se atrinchera en una casa

en.title: A woman dies stabbed by her partner in La Campana (Seville), who barricades himself in a house
en.summary: A woman was killed by her 56-year-old partner in La Campana, Seville. The Civil Guard deployed specialized negotiators to handle the barricaded suspect.

stories.title: La Policía Nacional desmantela un asentamiento de inmigrantes junto a la desalinizadora de Ceuta

en.title: National Police dismantle immigrant settlement next to Ceuta desalination plant
en.summary: Spanish National Police conducted a special operation involving 300 officers to dismantle an immigrant settlement located near a desalination facility in Ceuta.

stories.title: Detenidos varios hombres por delitos con explosivos cerca de la base militar aérea británica de Fairford, utilizada por el ejército estadounidense

en.title: Several men arrested for explosives offenses near British military air base at Fairford, used by US military
en.summary: Multiple men were arrested for explosives-related crimes near RAF Fairford, a British military base authorized for US military operations against Iranian missile targets in the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Un hombre mata a su pareja y se atrinchera en una casa de La Campana (Sevilla)

en.title: Man kills his partner and barricades himself in a house in La Campana, Seville
en.summary: A 56-year-old man killed his 47-year-old partner and barricaded himself inside a house in La Campana, Seville, according to investigation sources.

stories.title: Pedro Sánchez y Mamdani celebran los «tiros difíciles» de la izquierda jugando con bolas de papel en Nueva York

en.title: Pedro Sánchez and Mamdani celebrate the "difficult shots" of the left playing with paper balls in New York
en.summary: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez and New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani engaged in a playful paper ball tossing activity in Manhattan, referencing left-wing political ambitions through basketball metaphors.

stories.title: La policía desaloja el asentamiento en la playa ceutí de Benítez, próxima a la desalinizadora

en.title: Police evict settlement at Ceuta's Benítez beach, near desalination plant
en.summary: Authorities relocated immigrants from a beach settlement to a nearby open area as suitable accommodation facilities remain unavailable.

stories.title: Mike Leigh se alza con la Concha de Oro en su conmovedora despedida del cine

en.title: Mike Leigh wins Golden Shell in his moving farewell to cinema
en.summary: British director Mike Leigh received the top prize at a film festival for his film about compassion and care, marking a significant moment in his career despite his absence from the ceremony.

stories.title: Mike Leigh entrega una obra maestra a la Concha de Oro del Festival de San Sebastián

en.title: Mike Leigh delivers a masterpiece to the Golden Shell of the San Sebastián Film Festival
en.summary: British director Mike Leigh won multiple awards including the Golden Shell at the San Sebastián Festival for 'Tender Loving Care', a film advocating compassion and care. Actor Javier Cámara also won best supporting actor.

stories.title: ‘Tender Loving Care’, la emocionante despedida de Mike Leigh, inapelable Concha de Oro en el festival de San Sebastián 2026

en.title: 'Tender Loving Care', the moving farewell of Mike Leigh, undisputed Golden Shell at the 2026 San Sebastián festival
en.summary: Mike Leigh's 'Tender Loving Care' won the Golden Shell at the 2026 San Sebastián Film Festival. Javier Cámara received the Silver Shell for best supporting performance in 'Cinco minutos más', while 'La bola negra' won the audience award.

stories.title: Cientos de personas acampan en Sol por la vivienda: "O cae el rentismo, o cae el Gobierno"

en.title: Hundreds camp at Sol over housing: "Either rentism falls, or the Government falls"
en.summary: Protesters established a camp in central Madrid following a demonstration against evictions, voicing demands related to housing policies.

stories.title: Terrazas para apurar el buen tiempo

en.title: Terraces to make the most of good weather
en.summary: Outdoor dining spaces continue operating into early autumn at various times throughout the day.

en.title: The rise of the BRICS
en.summary: China seeks to position BRICS as an anti-Western bloc while India and Brazil work to preserve their geopolitical independence and influence.

stories.title: Cómo impacta el nuevo escenario de las divisas en la cartera

en.title: How the new currency scenario impacts your portfolio
en.summary: Central banks' simultaneous monetary shift strengthens the dollar and increases the appeal of US fixed income, benefiting European exporters.

stories.title: Mil días sin Presupuestos: los 'parches' superan los 330.000 millones

en.title: One thousand days without budgets: temporary measures exceed 330 billion euros
en.summary: The Government has redirected over 330 billion euros through credit expansions and interministerial transfers due to outdated budget allocations since 2023 budgets expired.
